rules.injection_frame: identical Gaussian Gaia registration for both models; isolates centroid/deblending effect
rules.real_frame: baseline Gaussian registration vs candidate IR-centroid training + median/MAD rejection
rules.gate: each new field, SNR and truth PSF: paired numerical RMS lower, P90 no higher, no fewer numerical fits or quality-accepted fits; real Gaia paired RMS no higher with >=3 common, no fewer numerical/accepted fits; no default WISE promotion
limits: known-position local fitting, not blind detection
blur is an assumed PSF perturbation, not independent physical calibration
conditional IRLS covariance; no neighbour-position, PSF or shared-frame systematic covariance
broad spectra only; default WISE 0855 measurement remains unchanged
